platformConsole.title: Administration Console
platformConsole.securityNote: Actions are limited to the current permission set. Tenant content, project data, and secrets are not available here.

dashboard.title: Tổng quan
dashboard.description: A bounded overview of the Platform data and health currently available to this account.

organizations.title: Tổ chức
organizations.description: Review Organization metadata, create an Organization, and inspect its current memberships.
organizations.readPermissionNeeded: Organization directory and detail require the exact Organization read permission.

users.title: Người dùng
users.description: Browse user accounts with search, status filters, and pagination. Select Details to view permitted account, membership, permission, and session information. Sensitive authentication data is not exposed.

memberships.title: Membership management
memberships.description: Review memberships for an Organization and suspend an eligible membership when authorized.

projects.title: Project management
projects.description: Platform-scoped Project metadata and access policy are not available in the current API.

security.title: Sessions & security
security.description: Review the current Platform session. Other-user session and security-event operations are unavailable.
security.currentAdminSessionGuard: Revoke is withheld for current Admin sessions because the API does not identify which session belongs to this browser.

services.title: Service operations
services.description: The current health capability reports IAM process liveness only.

jobs.title: Jobs & queues
jobs.description: Job and queue data or controls are not available to the Platform console.

ai.title: RAG & AI operations
ai.description: RAG, model, index and AI operational data are not available to the Platform console.

integrations.title: Integration management
integrations.description: Platform-scoped integration status and actions are not available.

incidents.title: Incident management
incidents.description: Incident data and actions are not available to the Platform console.

diagnostics.title: Support & diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Platform diagnostics are unavailable until a redacted Platform API is approved.

audit.title: Audit activity
audit.description: Review and filter the fixed bounded operational audit projection.

account.title: Platform account
account.description: Review the identity and current permission projection for this Platform session.

unavailable.badge: Unavailable in the current Platform API

capabilities.organizationDescription: Metadata editing, lifecycle changes, invitations, invitation resend/revoke, and membership role changes are not exposed here. Existing create, metadata read, membership read, and authorized suspension remain available above.
capabilities.organizationDependency: A Platform-authorized API, permission/scope, audit event, and QA contract for each missing Organization operation.
capabilities.organizationInvitations: Invite, resend, or revoke an invitation
capabilities.organizationMembershipRoles: Add/remove members or change Organization roles
capabilities.userTitle: User directory and lifecycle controls are unavailable
capabilities.userDescription: Organization creation only searches for an active account to assign as the first Manager. Use User management to browse accounts and review permitted details.
capabilities.userDependency: A Platform-scoped user directory and lifecycle contract with bounded fields, exact permissions, audit behavior, and QA coverage.
capabilities.userDetail: User detail and effective membership/role/permission view
capabilities.membershipDescription: This page supports only the current membership list and the separately permission-gated suspension action. No invitation, removal, role-change, or history endpoint is called.
capabilities.membershipDependency: Platform membership operation contracts for invite/resend/revoke/remove/role change/history, including scope, audit events, confirmation, and QA rules.
capabilities.membershipInvite: Invite a User to an Organization
capabilities.projectDescription: This console does not read Project metadata, visibility, or access policy. Organization-scoped Project APIs are not used with a Platform session.
capabilities.projectDependency: A Platform-authorized Project metadata/access API and its resource-scope, permission, audit, and QA contracts.
capabilities.securityTitle: Other-user session and security operations are unavailable
capabilities.securityDescription: Only the current Platform session identity is shown. Viewing or revoking other sessions, anomaly handling, and security event review are not exposed.
capabilities.securityDependency: A Platform-scoped session/security API with subject boundaries, confirmation, audit events, and safe response projection.
capabilities.securityRevoke: Revoke sessions or respond to anomalies
capabilities.serviceTitle: Dependency and service diagnostics are unavailable
capabilities.serviceDescription: Only IAM process liveness is available above. Database, queue, dependency, and other service status are not inferred from that response.
capabilities.serviceDependency: Approved Platform health projections for each service and dependency, with a clear liveness/readiness contract.
capabilities.jobsTitle: Job and queue operations are unavailable
capabilities.jobsDescription: No job list, payload, status, retry, cancellation, or queue controls are displayed or callable.
capabilities.jobsDependency: A bounded Platform job/queue API, allowed actions, audit contract, and payload-redaction rules.
capabilities.aiTitle: RAG and AI operations are unavailable
capabilities.aiDescription: No RAG content, prompts, retrieval results, index payloads, processing jobs, or tenant data are displayed or callable.
capabilities.aiDependency: An approved Platform operational projection for model/index health and job status that excludes tenant content and secrets.
capabilities.integrationDescription: No connection list, reconnect/test action, credentials, keys, or secret material are displayed or callable.
capabilities.integrationDependency: A safe Platform integration status/action API with explicit secret redaction, permission, and audit contracts.
capabilities.incidentDescription: No incident list, severity/status update, acknowledgement, resolution, notes, or incident audit trail is displayed or callable.
capabilities.incidentDependency: A Platform incident API defining allowed lifecycle actions, operational notes, access scope, and audit behavior.
capabilities.diagnosticsDescription: Request traces and troubleshooting output are not fetched or shown. This prevents unreviewed diagnostics from exposing secrets or tenant data.
capabilities.diagnosticsDependency: A Platform diagnostics API with a reviewed redaction contract and explicit safe output projection.

dashboard.totalOrganizations: Total reported by the Platform Organization directory.
dashboard.permissionNeeded: Unavailable: this session lacks the exact read permission or the Platform API is not available.
dashboard.userMetricsUnavailable: No Platform user-count projection is available.
dashboard.projectMetricsUnavailable: No Platform Project-count projection is available.
dashboard.iamHealthDetail: Liveness only; not dependency readiness or service metrics.
dashboard.recentActivityNote: Latest events from the fixed projection, limited to records returned by the audit API.
dashboard.auditError: Chưa có dữ liệu hoạt động.
dashboard.noRecentActivity: Chưa có hoạt động gần đây.
dashboard.noFabricatedMetrics: Unavailable metrics are omitted instead of being estimated from partial data.
dashboard.serviceHealthNote: The latest bounded service projection reported by the backend. Unavailable measurements are shown explicitly.

descriptions.organizations: Review Organization metadata, look up an eligible account, and perform the limited membership action available to your current permissions.
descriptions.health: Check IAM process liveness. This view does not report dependency readiness or service metrics.
descriptions.audit: Review the fixed operational audit projection. Export and raw event details are not available.

errors.signOut: Could not confirm sign out. Try again.
errors.userLookup: No eligible active account was found. Check the email and try again.
errors.organizationCreate: Organization creation was not confirmed. Review the details and retry.
errors.organizationUpdate: Could not update Organization metadata. Review the details and retry.
errors.organizationDetail: This Organization could not be loaded.
errors.invalidOrganizationId: The Organization link is invalid. Return to the directory and choose an Organization.
errors.membershipSuspend: Membership was not suspended. Refresh the Organization and check its current state.
errors.health: IAM health could not be checked.
errors.audit: Audit activity could not be loaded.
errors.organizationConflict: This organization changed or its slug is already in use. Refresh the details and review the latest information before retrying.

noCapabilities.title: No active console permissions
noCapabilities.body: This account can sign in, but it has no current V1 Platform Console permission. Contact the approved Platform authority process.
noCapabilities.organizationReadNeeded: Organization creation is available, but this session cannot read the Organization directory. Ask for the exact Organization read permission to review the result.

organizations.directoryHelp: A bounded list of Organization metadata. No tenant content is included.
organizations.emptyBody: There are no Organization records in this page.
organizations.createHelp: The selected active account becomes the first Organization Manager in the same backend transaction.

organizations.pageFilterNote: Tìm kiếm và gói dịch vụ áp dụng trên trang hiện tại.
organizations.planPercentNote: Share of organizations on the current page; not a system-wide plan breakdown.
organizations.noMatches: Không có tổ chức phù hợp trên trang này.
organizations.reloadBeforeEdit: Close this form, refresh the organization, then reopen it before trying again.

users.accountLookupPermissionNeeded: The exact account lookup permission is required to select the first Organization Manager.
users.lookupCreateNote: User lookup is used only to select the first Manager for Organization creation.

memberships.title: Organization memberships
memberships.organizationPermissionNeeded: Select an Organization requires the exact Platform Organization read permission. Membership APIs are scoped to one Organization.
memberships.readPermissionNeeded: This session does not have the exact membership read permission.
memberships.noOrganization: No Organization is available in the current directory response.
memberships.chooseOrganization: Choose an Organization to load memberships.
memberships.directoryNote: Current membership projection for the selected Organization. No invitation or role mutation is available here.
memberships.migrationRequired: Suspension unavailable until membership lifecycle metadata is initialized.
memberships.partialBody: Invite, resend, revoke, remove, role change, and membership history require separate Platform API and audit contracts. Only the currently authorized membership read and suspend operations are active.
memberships.emptyBody: This Organization has no memberships in the selected page.
memberships.confirmBody: Suspend access for {name}? This action changes Organization membership status and is recorded in the operational audit.
memberships.confirmGuard: The backend checks the current permission, Organization relationship, membership version, self-action rule, and last-Manager rule before writing.

health.title: IAM process liveness
health.iamOnly: This is process liveness only; database, queue, and dependency readiness are not included.

audit.title: Operational audit
audit.boundedNote: Latest fixed projection · up to 100 records · no export
audit.permissionNeeded: This session does not have the exact Platform audit read permission.
audit.localFilterNote: Showing {filtered} of {count} records returned by the bounded API. Filters apply only to this loaded projection.
audit.noFilterMatchesHelp: Adjust or clear the local filters. No additional records are requested from the backend.
audit.emptyBody: There are no events in the bounded audit projection.
